multiplayer.soldierSelection: Each player can choose any free Hale/Mercer/Ames/Webb slot in the briefing or during a mission; occupied slots are labelled, inventory persists, host status stays separate from command.

audio: 25 complete human performances: 15 clean squad/local recordings and 10 additional radio-only calls. Truthful contextual dispatch, local-only independent allied speech, real across-map fighting with propagation delay and distance/cover filtering. Routine orders share a 60-second cooldown; ordinary exact phrases rest for 180 seconds. Existing local/radio crossfades, room/street tails, voice slider and music remain.

mobile.camera: Controlled soldier stays centered in the usable area between HUD and thumb controls, including world edges and zoom transitions
mobile.guidance: Healthy world names and roles appear in Simple only; Expert removes routine world labels and coaching while preserving target markers and critical casualty cues
mobile.throwables: Gear opens grenade types and drag-to-aim throw; tray clears during aiming and closes after a completed throw
mobile.dock: Compact Squad / Gear dock; reload always reachable, Assist contextual; full-size thumb targets
mobile.pings: Squad > Ping a place or tap overview map; both roles, no changed movement order
mobile.aimPickup: Both sticks start neutral at the actual thumb pickup; bounded visual centers keep the rings inside their touch pads
mobile.objective: Compact title and progress, full explanation expands on demand
mobile.thumbstickGeometry: One centering rule in portrait and landscape keeps drawn rings and knobs aligned with the touch pads; no doubled portrait translation

desktop.camera: stable by default; camera and mouse input share one transform
desktop.aim: single adjustable reticle with optional cover cue
desktop.performance: cached effects, cropped map rendering, bounded render buffers, change-only HUD updates
desktop.diagnostics: F3: FPS, frame time and actual Canvas 2D buffer dimensions

guidance.simple: Larger text, plain explanations across objectives/squad/equipment/radio/settings, and a six-step action-driven introduction with skip/back/replay and saved progress.
guidance.moderate: Readable labels and concise help for current actions and combat state.

desktop.controls: All gameplay keys and mouse buttons can be rebound with two slots per action, explicit conflict resolution, saved preferences, and live-updating prompts. Escape always remains a safe menu/cancel route.
desktop.ping: Middle mouse or P by default: eight-second named blue location marker, one per soldier, shared in co-op; never changes squad orders or reveals enemies. Can be used on the map and while firing.

buildings.entry: Open north/south doorways, widened frontages, or explosive gaps in qualifying perimeter sections
buildings.interiors: shared walls, room partitions, decorative furnishings and automatic roof cutaways
buildings.sharedCollision: solo, AI navigation, bullets, sight lines, desktop aim and co-op prediction

destruction.scope: Localized side-wall cuts and doorway-adjacent frontage damage; corner supports, remaining walls, partitions and roof stay intact; no structural collapse

squad.soloSelection: HUD cards or rebindable soldier shortcuts, retaining each soldier state
squad.formation: Wider travel-oriented positions, staggered movement, individual cover, responsive explicit orders and doorway compression
squad.grenadier: slower; four launcher rounds and directional binoculars
squad.machineGunner: M249 SAW with 100-round belt; AI fires bounded 12-round strings at weapon cadence with pauses and reloads

worldVariation: Six distinct seeded mission layouts with district identities, parked sedans/pickups/vans, abandoned stalls, handcarts, work yards, materials and constrained fires; fixed routes, doors, casualty access and usable breach approaches reserved
visibility: Clear shared current sight, dim remembered terrain, and much darker unseen terrain on the battlefield and map; walls/smoke occlude contacts; strongly flashed observers stop scouting, recovery scales their vision range

enemies.encounters: Finite coherent 3–4-person authored groups (one extra on Veteran), placed at nearby approaches before the player reaches them; independent safe-placement retries and expiry; no random around-player reinforcement ring
enemies.behavior: Cover and reload refuges, expiring nearby group contact reports, opportunistic repositioning, sustained bounded gunner bursts; no fire through cover

story.continuation: Bounded supply costs, fatigue and civilian communication consequences across the four campaign chapters; fresh actor state each chapter; side operations remain independent
story.historicalFraming: fictional choices and composite encounters within documented raid-to-rescue context

casualties.bodies: persist until new mission or restart
casualties.blood: short hit spurts, persistent ground marks and small pools
casualties.visibility: shared sight, smoke, roofs, then stationary terrain memory

acoustics.environmentResponses: Existing room and indirect-street kernels plus a separate cached 2.8-second diffuse exterior kernel for unobstructed outdoor gunfire
acoustics.environmentGeometry: Source and listener rooms, walls, openings and breaches select the response; bounded approximation, not a full acoustic solver

earlyStreetReflections.geometry: Remaining exterior wall fragments; openings and breaches remove their reflecting surface
earlyStreetReflections.delay: Extra reflected-path travel after the direct arrival
earlyStreetReflections.voicePriority: Below direct reports; shares the 32-voice budget
earlyStreetReflections.indoorsAndOccluded: Use the existing room and indirect sound treatment

recordedWeaponTakes.source: Edited and separately shaped M249 recordings by Baelphazoar, CC BY 4.0; full attribution in audio/CREDITS.txt

exteriorResonance.strength: Scaled by source/listener street density; no added tail on empty open ground
exteriorResonance.indoors: Existing exterior tails and scheduled facade returns continue with smooth listener attenuation and post-convolution low-pass filtering; new indoor shots retain their established room treatment; pause/mute/role changes still flush history

lateStreetEchoes.geometry: Large remaining exterior facade with clear outgoing and return paths; removed wall sections cannot reflect
lateStreetEchoes.priority: Below direct gunfire, within the existing 32-voice limit

cityAmbience.sourcePlacement: Stable district anchors and map perimeter; never generated around the listener
cityAmbience.combatSource: Actual simulated shot/explosion events; synthetic mission battle cues disabled

footsteps.source: Fantozzi, CC0; full attribution in audio/CREDITS.txt

districtCombat.distantShotBudget: 4-token burst, 8 per second beyond 650 world units
districtCombat.nearbyPriority: Nearby player/squad fire bypasses distant sampling
districtCombat.distanceTreatment: Travel delay, stronger low-pass and reduced detail with distance, geometry occlusion and existing acoustic tails

acoustics.fieldSpeech: Independent allied speech stays physical/local; it never becomes a remote player radio message

missionSelection.continuation: Chronological campaign only; Dawn Mile completes the campaign

navigation.routes: Clearance-aware paths through doors and breaches, reachable destinations, and recovery from blocked movement
navigation.civilians: Threatened residents seek reachable shelter, remain sheltered through nearby danger, or cower if immobilized; rescued residents follow escort routes

nightEffects.trigger: Actual shot events at weapon positions
nightEffects.illumination: Brighter night-only muzzle cores and broader warm light pools; brief shot-driven peaks, wall/roof/smoke visibility gates, cached sprites and bounded shot geometry
nightEffects.reducedMotion: Retains a dimmer muzzle core without local glow
nightEffects.sourceFlash: Visible night sources require unobstructed squad sight; no persistent marker or terrain revelation

streetLife.staticCover: Parked civilian vehicles and material stacks share collision with AI navigation, sight, bullets and co-op prediction
streetLife.dressing: District-specific laundry, handcarts, tires, barrels, sacks and rubble
streetLife.firePresentation: Positioned crackle, bounded flames and smoke; observed visibility and wall-clipped glow

throwables.desktop: Default Y selects Frag/Flash/Smoke; N throws toward aim. G throws smoke, V fires the grenadier launcher. All shortcuts can be rebound.
throwables.mobile: Tap type to select; drag Throw to aim and release; return to button to cancel.
throwables.frag: Timed thrown blast; walls shield actors; exposed allies/civilians can be harmed; no masonry breach.
throwables.flashbang: Nonlethal LOS and distance exposure; strong shared-room effect; smooth vision/hearing recovery; brief configurable ringing; blinded AI pauses firing and scouting.
throwables.flight: Short arc, wall stop, ground fuse; no bounce/roll simulation.
throwables.coop: Server-authoritative inventory/exposure, per-action aim latching, explicit pause/cancel, protocol11.

independentSquads.spawn: Finite initial patrol, crossing relief and building garrison; no invisible around-player spawn ring
independentSquads.orders: Own routes, short halts, cohesion/regroup, actual contacts and heard shots, earlier withdrawal to reachable refuge, finite bandaging and recovery, completed patrol return to staging
independentSquads.training: Group and seed-dependent cohesion; well-organized defenders coexist with looser patrols
independentSquads.buildingGuards: Interior posts with a real navigable doorway; Story can omit extra guards when the existing threat budget is full
independentSquads.sight: Only the playable four supply shared sight; unseen NPC positions and private orders excluded from co-op snapshots and local reconstruction
independentSquads.combat: Real ammunition, reloads, projectiles, cover, suppression, recoverable casualties and at most one safe frag and one casualty-aid smoke per field group
independentSquads.playerResponsibility: Offscreen NPC kills and collateral do not inflate player kill/civilian-harm statistics; player-caused harm still counts
independentSquads.missionCompletion: Independent squads do not join playable roster, require extraction, or add kill-all gates

fieldSupport.request: Mobile Squad or desktop Squad orders > Request support here > select a map location; either living co-op player can request the same finite reserve
fieldSupport.response: Prepositioned soldiers physically travel to reachable cover, report delays, cover and aid nearby wounded, then return to staging; emergency friendly requests share this reserve
fieldSupport.treatment: Finite medical supply; 3 seconds for a medic, 4.5 for others; partial health recovery and group withdrawal
fieldSupport.scope: On-map recovery and staging; no dragging, vehicle evacuation, or campaign casualty persistence

gunplay.visuals: Actual-shot weapon kick and distinct muzzle profiles; short actual-path streaks; surface-directed chips, sparks, splinters and dust; bounded casings and powder; current sight, smoke, wall and roof gates
gunplay.reducedMotion: Quieter muzzle and impact cues without added weapon/body kick, casing motion or powder
gunplay.audio: Existing credited recordings with distinct broad playback EQ, restrained continuation-round gain/reflection feed, priority for own and close incoming fire, cached procedural surface contacts and clearer real near passes
gunplay.mechanics: Presentation changes retain projectile physics and aim coordinates; no added ricochet physics
gunplay.mobileAim: Existing neutral pickup and aim/fire thresholds are unchanged in this release

people: Stable clothing, skin, headwear, load-bearing kit and small build differences; boots, shoulder seams, packs, radios, hands and readable specialties. Individual gait phases, restrained idle movement, reload gestures and reduced-motion support. Independent friendly squads use a distinct ring and leader callsign.

validation.nativeCanvasNote: Production renderer exercised with a CPU rasterizer; not a physical device or browser FPS claim
